gaps.lead: 'Have you seen my keys anywhere?' he asked us.
gaps.sentence: He asked us ___ seen his keys anywhere.
gaps.explanation: if/whether + subject + had + participle: whether we had seen.

gaps.lead: 'I broke the window,' said the boy.
gaps.explanation: admit + -ing (optionally 'to'): admitted breaking / admitted to breaking.

gaps.lead: I haven't enjoyed myself so much for years.
gaps.sentence: It's ___ I've enjoyed myself so much.
gaps.explanation: It's years since + past simple = I haven't…for years.

gaps.lead: I only understood the joke much later.
gaps.explanation: After 'only + time phrase' at the front, invert: Only much later did I understand.

gaps.lead: 'You've stolen my idea!' he said to her.
It was a mistake to sell the boat.
gaps.explanation: should/shouldn't have + past participle criticises a past action.
